approved_aura_offers_status: APPROVED reference list from Tapiwa, 3 Nov 2026 (wording as relayed by Yuliia). Rules: Launchpad is only 'proposed'; Equity Studio acceptance and equity terms are never promised; Sprints and Managed Execution are not described as available until terms are approved.

approved_aura_offers.name: AURA AI Free
approved_aura_offers.text: AURA AI Free, $0: core founder workspace and AI assistance with an included usage allowance.

approved_aura_offers.name: AURA AI Pro
approved_aura_offers.text: AURA AI Pro, $99/month or $828/year: Company DNA, pitch decks, financial planning, investor-readiness tools, Data Rooms, AI assistance and other advanced features.

approved_aura_offers.name: AURA Startup Launchpad
approved_aura_offers.text: AURA Startup Launchpad, proposed $5,000 package: a more hands-on service covering startup foundations, including a pitch deck, financial projections, lightweight website, business model review and go-to-market planning.

approved_aura_offers.name: AURA Equity Studio
approved_aura_offers.text: AURA Equity Studio: a selective, application-based venture-building pathway where AURA may consider providing services in exchange for equity. About to be commercially live. Acceptance or equity terms must never be promised.

approved_aura_offers.name: Investor-Ready Sprints and Managed Execution Services
approved_aura_offers.text: Investor-Ready Sprints and Managed Execution Services: part of the wider commercial model. Final customer-facing terms must be approved before they are advertised as available.
approved_aura_offers.human_check_reason: Additional commercial offer, not approved as available to customers yet. Needs a human check before it is mentioned (Tapiwa decides).
